Any key > 17 or < 0 is MIDI: add n, read mod 12, and lift every key by the same octaves until each is > 17. pianoSoundingPitchClasses no longer scores absolute versus interval. scorePianoReadings, characteristicIntervals, and characteristicCount are gone. chord-dict.ts does not import define.ts. Guitar and ukulele packs were not edited. Fretted identity stayed 17 * 12 * 2 = 408.

{define: Dsus2 keys 0 7} +5 stores Gsus2 keys [0, 7] and lights G D. −5 stores Dsus2 keys [0, 7] and lights D A. +3 stores Fsus2 keys [0, 7] and lights F C. −3 stores [0, 7] and lights D A.

{define: C keys 0 2} +2 stores D keys [0, 2] and lights D E. −2 stores C keys [0, 2] and lights C D. transpose and exportCho do not throw.
